from pathlib import Path
import re
for p in Path('/var/ossec/ruleset/rules').glob('*.xml'):
 text=p.read_text(errors='replace')
 for m in re.finditer(r'<rule\b[^>]*\bid="(?:62100|62123|62124|62125|62126|62152|63103|63104)".*?</rule>',text,re.S):
  print(str(p));print(m.group(0))
print(Path('/var/ossec/etc/ossec-init.conf').read_text())
